portal_hypertension.title: Changes in SSM Assessed via 100 Hz-VCTE Are Associated With Acute HVPG-Response to i.v. Propranolol: A European Multicentre Study.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Thöne P, Saltini D, Calvão J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于多中心临床研究。核心观点：普萘洛尔可预测晚期慢性肝病 (ACLD) 和有临床意义的门脉高压 (CSPH) 患者的预后。 临床提示：急性肝静脉压力梯度（HVPG）对静脉注射的反应
portal_hypertension.abstract: The acute hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG)-response to i.v. propranolol predicts outcomes in patients with advanced chronic liver disease (ACLD) and clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH). While non-invasive tests (NIT) to monitor non-selective beta-blocker (NSBB)-induced HVPG changes are lacking, spleen stiffness measurement (SSM) has shown promising results as a surrogate for HVPG. This study aimed to assess the correlation between changes in SSM at 100 Hz and HVPG upon acute i.v. propranolol. ACLD patients with CSPH undergoing paired HVPG and SSM-100 Hz assessments pre- and post-i.v. propranolol (0.15 mg/kg) at three expert centres between 2019 and 2024 were included. HV...

portal_hypertension.title: Imaging assessment and interventional management of paediatric portal hypertension: an update.
portal_hypertension.authors: Jürgens J, Marra P, Valle C
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：与成人相比，儿童门静脉高压症具有独特的病因、临床表现和治疗策略，因此准确的影像学评估在整个诊断和治疗途径中至关重要。 临床提示：超声仍然是一线检查方式，可实时评估血管解剖结构、血流动力学、脾脏受累和门体循环。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension in children presents distinct etiologies, clinical manifestations, and management strategies compared with adults, making accurate imaging evaluation essential across the diagnostic and therapeutic pathway. Ultrasound remains the first-line modality, providing real-time assessment of vascular anatomy, haemodynamics, splenic involvement, and portosystemic collaterals. Colour Doppler ultrasound and pulsed-wave Doppler ultrasound, along with systematic scanning protocols, enable early identification of portal vein obstruction, cavernous transformation, and hepatofugal flow patterns. portal_hypertension.title: Therapeutic endoscopic ultrasound with a novel adaptable endoscopic ultrasound probe and vision system.
portal_hypertension.journal: VideoGIE : an official video journal of the American Society for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy
portal_hypertension.authors: Robles-Medranda C, Arevalo-Mora M, Del Valle R
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：EUS 受到成本、复杂性和交叉污染风险的限制。 临床提示：一次性 EUS (DP-EUS) 探头可以扩大可及性，同时保持诊断和治疗能力。
portal_hypertension.abstract: EUS is limited by cost, complexity, and cross-contamination risks. Disposable EUS (DP-EUS) probes may expand accessibility while maintaining diagnostic and therapeutic capabilities. We report the use of a novel DP-EUS for diverse GI procedures.
